meta.reach_definition: Taps needed before the control or information is visible, counting from Today (or from the item it belongs to). glance = visible on Today, widget, Lock Screen, Watch or a notification with no navigation; one-tap = visible after one tap (row, chip, Log key, header chip); two-taps = after two; details-layer = inside the item's own detail/history/report sheet; settings = in a settings place (You tab, item Settings section, Routine editor).
meta.ids: cmsg ids are full ids from owner-messages.md; "default": true means Mark and the contract are silent on placement and this is a reasoned default
meta.current: current = the ledger's evidence line for the Base-7 prototype (where it lives now)

rules.rule: Logging anything done several times a day is at a glance: its one-tap control sits on Today, the widget and the Watch. No confirm screen. Undo appears in the toast.
rules.source: Mark cmsg_01Ju1d1RXQsRdZdTG83zTouUT8mmMTKjmY9x4Nz2SnM7Rb: 'Logging water, recording medication, noting how I feel, or completing a simple routine must remain extremely fast'; Mark cmsg_01Ju1d1RXQsRdZdTG83zTouUGhMtrq6ezVuBGh85v2zx4w (brief): 'One tap should record a familiar amount'; R-11; Mark cmsg_01Ju1d1RXQsRdZdTG83zTouUKZtqasSazWP4MR7asQ4kSG: 'No unnecessary confirmation screens. Undo and correction should feel natural and immediate'

rules.rule: Anything needed while doing a routine is visible without navigating: Start/End, time elapsed, time left and the 'past your usual' cue sit on the live bar, Live Activity and Watch.
rules.source: A-evidence #5: visible remaining time for a running session (Live Activity, Watch); A-evidence #9 hyperfocus stop point; C-timing §5 'nothing sits in a list waiting to be remembered'

rules.rule: Deadlines and commitments are never lost. They stay at a glance (Today 'By a date', widget, Lock Screen) for their whole window, even when Mark is sick, travelling or resting, and they never read 'overdue'.
rules.source: Mark cmsg_01Ju1d1RXQsRdZdTG83zTouUFmXyEbqwBBWKYArCM6EcVw: 'A Thursday trash deadline should not disappear'; C-timing §1: commitments surface the whole window and context can never suppress them

rules.rule: A held intention comes back once at the moment Mark picked, then stays visible without pushing again. Capturing one is one tap from the Log key and takes one line plus a 'when'. There are no priorities, due dates or categories.
rules.source: C-timing §5: 'after the cue, the item stays visible on the widget or Watch… Every held item has a next moment'; A-evidence #1 one-line capture plus an event cue; F-eval guardrails against drift into a task manager

rules.rule: Today shows only what is open now: routines due in this period, dated items and at most one suggestion. Rare, configured and finished things are one tap away (Routines, Log key, search), never on Today.
rules.source: Mark cmsg_01Ju1d1RXQsRdZdTG83zTouUKZtqasSazWP4MR7asQ4kSG: 'What actually deserves attention right now? What can remain available without being constantly displayed?'; Mark cmsg_01Ju1d1RXQsRdZdTG83zTouUKZtqasSazWP4MR7asQ4kSG 'too much cognitive and visual competition'; A-evidence decision paralysis

rules.rule: On Today, size follows relevance, not frequency. A high-frequency routine like water is a normal row and never the hero that pushes rarer, more meaningful items down.
rules.source: ledger SC-04; R-04 'Low-frequency and irregular routines are first-class'

rules.rule: Proactive help shows one thing at a time: one suggestion slot below the routines, one reason line, Start and Not now visible, everything else behind ⋯. Turning it off leaves Today complete.
rules.source: A-evidence #6: 'Offer one idea at a time… a rule (at most one)'; F-eval: suggestions are the highest noise risk; C-timing §4 'without showing five buttons'; EF brief §7 'Preserve direct control'

rules.rule: Results come in two layers. The headline (last night, the run, this week) is one tap from Today or the row. Charts, stages, splits and comparisons sit lower in the same report. Patterns and analysis are a separate layer under Time, and Today shows at most one rare pattern card.
rules.source: Mark cmsg_01Ju1d1RXQsRdZdTG83zTouUKZtqasSazWP4MR7asQ4kSG: 'Clear distinctions between headline results and deeper analysis… Smooth navigation between overview and details'; §1 optional advanced depth 'never overwhelms the everyday experience'; R-19

rules.rule: Correction lives in the details layer (entry sheet, Day view). Immediate undo lives in the toast. Today rows never show edit controls.
rules.source: R-11 'forgiving input with immediate undo'; R-09 'Corrections are allowed; repairing past records is never required'; ledger LG-15 'without inviting obsessive re-editing'

rules.rule: Medication logging is one tap from the Log key, the Watch or a reminder action. It is neutral: no reward, no streak and no Today to-do row. Its history and corrections sit two taps away under You → Medication.
rules.source: Mark cmsg_01Ju1d1RXQsRdZdTG83zTouUT8mmMTKjmY9x4Nz2SnM7Rb: 'Logging water, recording medication, noting how I feel, or completing a simple routine must remain extremely fast'; P-3; R-22; Mark cmsg_01Ju1d1RXQsRdZdTG83zTouUKZtqasSazWP4MR7asQ4kSG: 'Medication quantity must never receive extra rewards'; R-12 'Never defines the product identity'

rules.rule: Observations (caffeine, alcohol, symptoms) are one tap from the Log key and its Recent chips, with optional details in the logger. They are never rewarded and never sit on Today as a to-do.
rules.source: R-08 observations never rewarded; Mark cmsg_01Ju1d1RXQsRdZdTG83zTouUKZtqasSazWP4MR7asQ4kSG: 'Neutral observations should not receive celebratory feedback'; R-10 'Not central'

rules.rule: Feelings are recorded on demand, one tap from the Log key, the Watch or a header chip when the module is on. There is no schedule, no badge and no prompt, and one tap is the whole check-in.
rules.source: Mark cmsg_01Ju1d1RXQsRdZdTG83zTouUT8mmMTKjmY9x4Nz2SnM7Rb: 'Logging water, recording medication, noting how I feel, or completing a simple routine must remain extremely fast'; R-13 'no imposed regular check-ins'; AS-14

rules.rule: After a gap, Today is the normal Today with one welcome line. There is no backlog, no list of missed days and no catch-up prompt. Filling past gaps is possible in the Day view and never asked for.
rules.source: R-21; AS-10 'Nothing lost or overdue'; R-09 'repairing past records is never required'

rules.rule: Context is one tap from the Today header chip and lasts for a span. It is never asked for and never guessed. A context can quiet ideas but never commitments.
rules.source: R-15 'one tap'; C-timing §7

rules.rule: Configuration lives in exactly one place per item: its detail page's Settings section, or the Routine editor at creation. Global policy (reminder cap, quiet hours, modules, connections) lives under You. Settings never appear on Today.
rules.source: Mark cmsg_01Ju1d1RXQsRdZdTG83zTouUKZtqasSazWP4MR7asQ4kSG 'control without being forced to configure dozens of settings'; ledger OT-21

rules.rule: Reminder setup shows what will actually arrive (a preview of the notification and its answers) inside the reminder sheet. Answering happens on the notification itself, with at most 3 actions.
rules.source: Mark cmsg_01Ju1d1RXQsRdZdTG83zTouUUWsXyJku7h72ieFbUTZgzA: 'A reminder settings screen is not a complete reminder experience'; C-timing §4

rules.rule: Permissions are asked one at a time, at the moment a feature needs them (calendar when a calendar cue is picked, location when 'When I get home' is picked), and never as a batch in onboarding.
rules.source: F-eval: ask for each permission only when Mark picks a moment that needs it

rules.rule: Optional modules (medication, feel, observations, Screen Time) are reachable in two taps from You → Records and from the Log key. When a module is off it leaves no trace anywhere.
rules.source: Mark cmsg_01Ju1d1RXQsRdZdTG83zTouUUWsXyJku7h72ieFbUTZgzA: 'elegantly accessible without dominating the application'; AS-17 'Nothing appears missing'

rules.rule: Labels say what a section is. If a section on Today needs a footnote to be understood, rename or merge it. Every gesture has a visible button equivalent, and search on the Today header finds items, settings, places and held things.
rules.source: Mark cmsg_01Ju1d1RXQsRdZdTG83zTouUJXN3g6ZgmBPYdFNKR9K8pM: 'Current version is just confusing, I have no clue what is what'; Mark cmsg_01Ju1d1RXQsRdZdTG83zTouUT8mmMTKjmY9x4Nz2SnM7Rb 'How do these interactions remain discoverable and accessible?'

rules.rule: The 3D stage is the hero but never pushes the primary control below the fold. On Today, the first open row must show on the first screen, and on a routine page the log control sits above or beside the object.
rules.source: Mark cmsg_01Ju1d1RXQsRdZdTG83zTouUUAQxa3MsKpeLUi4HDveb1r 'Love the 3d elements… also layout issues'; Mark cmsg_01Ju1d1RXQsRdZdTG83zTouUT8mmMTKjmY9x4Nz2SnM7Rb: 'Logging water, recording medication, noting how I feel, or completing a simple routine must remain extremely fast'; default
